summary: HR Phase 3 (Tasks, Annual Appraisals, HR Dashboard summary, Automated Alerts) tested end-to-end. Backend: 37/37 pytest cases passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend: all requested data-testids present and behavior matches spec on admin, EMP-200 (manager) and EMP-100 (employee). No blocking issues found.

issues: Landing tab defaults to 'فريقي' even though EMP-100 has no team; user must switch to 'تقييمي' to see approved appraisals. Consider auto-selecting the tab that has data for the current user, or defaulting employees to hr-appr-tabs-my.

critical_code_review_comments: hr_tasks.py progress endpoint: order of operations means an assignee posting {progress:50} while task is 'open' correctly promotes to 'in_progress' via the `progress > 0 and status == 'open'` branch, but this branch is only reached if data.status is None (status := t.status). OK today, but a request that sends {status:'open', progress:80} would keep status='open' contrary to expectation — worth an explicit note or refactor.

hr_appraisals.py _access.manager uses can_act_on(..., perm='__none__') which effectively bypasses HR perm check and returns True whenever the target is in the current user's direct team — this is intentional (managers should read their team's drafts) but the '__none__' sentinel is fragile; prefer a dedicated helper.

hr_alerts.run_daily_alerts uses `_once` keyed by `daily_{date}` and mutates state on force=False; the run_now endpoint uses force=True which correctly bypasses. Confirmed idempotent behavior in tests.
hr_alerts.hr_dashboard_summary duplicates count queries for present/absent that were already used to derive `unmarked_today` — minor perf; acceptable.
hr_common.can_act_on takes an unused-but-accepted perm value; when caller passes '__none__' HR check trivially fails and manager check runs — see appraisals comment above.
seed_data_creation: Created via backend tests: additional tasks assigned by EMP-200 to EMP-100 (TEST_task_p3 marked done, TEST_cancel cancelled by assigner, TEST_del deleted). Appraisal 6ab42193ce78fea2f1416d28 was cycled: draft → all-5s (100 ممتاز) → submitted → returned by admin → resubmitted → approved → acknowledged by EMP-100 with comment 'شكراً'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Existing appraisal for EMP-100 year 2026 is now status=acknowledged with total_score=100 (all criteria =5). The default tab on /hr-appraisals for EMP-100 is 'فريقي' which is empty; user must click hr-appr-tabs-my to see the approved appraisal — this is a UX suggestion, not a bug. run-now?kind=daily and ?kind=weekly both succeed and honor force=True. Notifications endpoint was not exercised because it wasn't strictly requested; task/leave alert flows verified only via response counts.
rca of the issue: No blocking bug this iteration. Note: initial page.goto('/hr-tasks') returned ERR_ABORTED because the previous page's SPA router hadn't fully committed after login; using wait_until='domcontentloaded' + a retry via window.location.href resolved it — no product bug.
